items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 04 October 2026 at 11:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasionally strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and high pressure to the south of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 at times in central areas.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in places at first, soon decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening, then veering north or northwest.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate at first, becoming mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain.
